description: This file defines the 'Process' class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing functionality for process management including launching, killing, and monitoring processes, as well as nested 'Options' class for command-line argument handling.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Encapsulates process creation, control, and monitoring, supporting both Windows and Linux platforms.

classes.name: Process::Options
classes.description: Handles command-line options and argument building for process execution.

methods.name: Process::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the process is currently active.

methods.name: Process::Kill
methods.description: Terminates the process, either gracefully or forcefully.

methods.name: Process::WaitProcessCompleted
methods.description: Waits for the process to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Process::Options::Add
methods.description: Adds a command-line parameter or options.

methods.name: Process::Options::Get
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the options.

methods.name: Process::Options::LineSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the command line string.

methods.name: Process::Options::BlockSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the argument array for process launch.

methods.name: Process::Options::Line
methods.description: Builds the command line string into a buffer.

methods.name: Process::Options::Block
methods.description: Builds the argument array into a buffer.
